verdict.rationale: The pack contains first-party documentation pages for Bits AI and Datadog Watchdog™, which point to built-in AI and automated-insight features, and a community comment cites outlier analysis as a Datadog advantage. However, the evidence is only page titles plus one thin mention, with no description of what insights or suggestions the user actually gets. A critic's complaint that users are not shown anomalies is general skepticism, not a concrete failure of these features, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: any documented description of Bits AI or Watchdog generating insights or suggestions from user data, scope of the insights (anomalies, root cause, recommendations), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Outlier analysis cited as a key advantage of Datadog and New Relic over open-source alternatives.
